verdict.rationale: Codex offers substantial programmatic surfaces: `codex exec` for scripted runs and CI, `codex cloud` to browse chats, submit work to cloud environments, and apply results from the terminal, and a JSON-RPC control interface via `codex mcp-server`, now deprecated in favor of the 'app server'. However, there is no documented Codex-specific REST API for cloud tasks and no stated UI/API parity, and a community report says a new Codex model was available in the product but not yet on the API. missing for 10: documented REST/SDK API for Codex cloud tasks and reviews, an explicit parity guarantee between UI and API, same-day API availability of new Codex models, documentation of the replacement app-server API.
